triggers.query: Can you check my thesis before I submit it? It's in output/thesis.pdf
I'm about to hand in my bachelor dissertation (output/thesis.pdf): anything I should fix first?
Summarise the paper in output/paper.pdf in five bullet points
Fix the typos in chapter 2 of my thesis
What grade would my thesis get?

evals.prompt: Pre-check my thesis before submission: output/thesis.pdf
evals.expected_output: A report following the template, listing the planted defects as issues with their pages
assertions: The report follows assets/report-template.md (summary, then a table of issues)
Every issue has a severity, a kind (objective or judgement), a page, and evidence
Repeated words found by the script are reported as minor objective issues
The report does not rewrite any part of the thesis, nor grade it
